issue_context.title: Lightning: MyDumpLoader Can Return Partial Result on Error
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
Currently, if something wrong happened on constructing the MyDumperLoader object, a nil is returned.  However, in some situations, it is caused by the context deadline exceeded.  In this situation, we may want to see the partial result of MyDumperLoader.

review_comments:
should this need to change too ?
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/5209ac2fa1a3db278661588370786b2991728320/br/pkg/lightning/restore/precheck.go#L76
You are right.  Will push the patch soon
no need to check `ReturnPartialResultOnError`? maybe comment why we always use partial result here.

Because originally, `NewMyDumpLoader` will always return nil when error occurs.  Now this behavior is changed only the user adds the `ReturnPartialResultOnError` option when constructing the MDL.  So, if returned mdl is not nil, we can infer that users sets the `ReturnPartialResultOnError` option or equivalents.
